lemmas.lemma: nød lærer naken kvinne å spinne
lemmas.primary_translation: when one is in a difficult situation, one is forced to find a solution

word_forms.word_form: nød lærer naken kvinne å spinne

definitions.text: når en er i en vanskelig situasjon, tvinges en til å finne en løsning
definitions.translation: when one is in a difficult situation, one is forced to find a solution (lit. necessity teaches a naked woman to spin)
